items.title: Include additional checks, such as `ruff check`, in `uv check`
items.reason: Origin of the request: a comment proposes selecting Pyrefly, pyright, or mypy. Maintainer zsol explicitly opened astral-sh/uv#22941 to track checker selection separately because astral-sh/uv#19768 concerns additional checks. Related, but not a duplicate.

items.title: Allow users to specify a custom ty configuration file when running `uv check`
items.reason: Adjacent customization request for the same command, but it selects a ty configuration file while retaining ty. It does not request switching type checkers.

related.search_scope: Searched astral-sh/uv open and closed issues and open, closed, and merged pull requests using literal terms "uv check", "type checker", and "ty-version"; conceptual combinations involving mypy, pyright, Pyrefly, custom/configurable checkers, alternative checkers, and backends; and area:uv-check/check-command searches for implementations or fixes. Inspected candidate bodies, comments, and cross-reference timelines, including linked astral-sh/ty-pre-commit#7 and facebook/pyrefly#3176. No matching implementation PR surfaced. Ruled out astral-sh/uv#19768 as a duplicate because its maintainer explicitly split this request into the new issue. Also distinguished astral-sh/uv#19791 (ty configuration), astral-sh/uv#16314 (linting), astral-sh/uv#5903 (general task running), and closed astral-sh/uv#21551 (workspace exclusions).

type_reason: The request adds checker selection to a command whose current implementation directly invokes ty and exposes ty-specific version selection. No incorrect behavior or regression is reported. Although alternative checkers were discussed in astral-sh/uv#19768, a maintainer explicitly created this issue to track that capability separately.
summary: astral-sh/uv#19768 is the originating discussion and explicitly delegates checker selection to this issue. astral-sh/uv#19791 concerns configuring ty rather than replacing it. No duplicate or implementing pull request was found.
draft_response: The customization you're requesting isn't supported yet: `uv check` currently invokes ty, and `--ty-version` only selects its version. This issue tracks checker selection separately from the additional checks discussed in astral-sh/uv#19768. The next step is to define how projects select a checker and how uv passes the environment and supported options. For now, you can add your preferred checker as a development dependency and invoke it through `uv run`, for example `uv run mypy .`.
